title: Visual Editor Enhancements: overview film
description: See the Entries panel, the editing form and field settings in action. English narration with captions in English, German, Chinese and Hungarian.
alt: Visual Editor Enhancements overview, 73 seconds. The Entries panel, entry editing, field settings, element library, rich text and links. English narration with captions in four languages.

transcript.text: Editing an element means managing its entries, too.
Visual Editor Enhancements keeps both close to the page.
Choose Entries beside settings. A compact panel lists the questions, cards or list items.
Rename an entry right in the list. For text and media, Edit in form opens the TYPO3 form.
Add an entry below the list. New entries start hidden. Adding and removing save immediately.
Field settings stay in their own panel. These changes wait for the next Save.
Find new elements in the library, with live previews and search that forgives typos.
The rich-text toolbar sits in one row above the text.
Hover a button, and a chain icon opens the link browser.
Enable collection editing in your user settings. Then open a page and try Entries.
